findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode probe matched prefers-color-scheme: dark, but body stayed rgb(255,255,255) with color-scheme: normal; the dark screenshot is visually identical to light.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and supply preference-driven surface, text and control colors using prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Navigation changes are abrupt rather than continuity-preserving.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection found no view-transition rules or names across the homepage, section and article templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Add same-document or cross-document View Transitions for route changes, with reduced-motion fallbacks.

findings.summary: Long pages provide static fixed chrome but no scroll-position feedback.
findings.evidence: The 44,249px mobile homepage keeps fixed header/tapbar chrome; DOM/CSS inspection found no scroll-state query or progress treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state container queries or a lightweight progress/affordance treatment so long-page position is clear.

findings.summary: Floating UI is manually placed rather than anchored to its trigger or context.
findings.evidence: The visible “Lo esencial de hoy” floating panel points at the fixed tapbar, while DOM inspection found no anchor-positioning declarations.
findings.suggestedFix: Anchor contextual overlays with CSS anchor positioning and position-try fallbacks.

findings.summary: Fixed overlays and navigation obscure the primary content on mobile.
findings.evidence: Homepage, section and article screenshots show a large “Lo esencial de hoy” panel plus a fixed four-item tapbar covering the bottom of the viewport; ads also precede lead content.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unsolicited floating prompts from initial reading, reserve fixed chrome only when essential, and ensure any prompt is compact and dismissible without covering content.

findings.summary: The dismissible floating panel does not use a semantic overlay primitive.
findings.evidence: A closeable floating panel is visible, yet the DOM reported zero dialog, popover, details, and role=dialog elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement transient UI with popover and declarative light-dismiss, or dialog for a genuinely modal flow, with an accessible close control.

findings.summary: Promotional and navigation chrome dominates the mobile reading viewport.
findings.evidence: The first mobile viewport contains subscription chrome, masthead, horizontal nav, scores, an ad, a video card, a floating prompt and a fixed tapbar, leaving little uninterrupted editorial content.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce stacked persistent regions, defer promotional modules, and prioritize the lead headline or article body in the initial viewport.

findings.summary: Components appear viewport-responsive but do not use component-level responsiveness.
findings.evidence: All four narrow layouts fit without overflow, but DOM/CSS inspection found no @container or container-type usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt container queries for reusable cards, score modules and masthead subcomponents that appear in different layout contexts.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and touch-target support are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The focused skip link computed to outline: none 0px; Lighthouse also reported undersized 14px-high author/category targets.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a strong :focus-visible style and expand target hit areas/spacing to at least the WCAG target-size floor.

findings.summary: Mobile loading is slow despite low observed CLS.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 4.6s, Speed Index 8.3s, TBT 310ms and TTI 28.1s (performance 0.62); CLS was 0.054.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP asset, reduce startup JavaScript and advertising work, and delay nonessential modules until after content is usable.

findings.summary: The critical resource path is large and fragmented.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 169 requests and 4,203,894 transferred bytes, including 58 scripts (2.49MB) and numerous VeryHigh-priority parser-inserted stylesheets; several scripts lack compression/cache headers.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate and inline only critical CSS, compress/cache scripts, prioritize the LCP image, and defer route-specific and advertising resources.

findings.summary: Large amounts of JavaScript and CSS are unused on initial load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 1,188KiB unused JavaScript and 38KiB unused CSS; prebid.js alone was 81% unused and the main Nuxt bundle 48% unused.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by template, conditionally load ad/subscription dependencies, and remove duplicated or unused CSS/JS.

findings.summary: Important controls and images lack accessible names or alternatives.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility found the mobile menu button without an accessible name and multiple images without alt attributes; accessibility score was 0.69.
findings.suggestedFix: Name the menu button, add meaningful alt text or empty alt for decorative images, and audit injected consent/promotional UI.

findings.summary: Heading order and visible keyboard focus are unreliable.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found heading levels skipping to h5, while an explicit focus probe showed the focused skip link had no outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a logical heading hierarchy and a consistent high-contrast :focus-visible treatment on every interactive element.

findings.summary: Several text links have insufficient touch area or spacing.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse target-size audit failed for 14px-high author and category links, although viewport scaling and 360px reflow passed.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase inline link line-height/padding or spacing so targets provide at least 24x24 CSS px safe clickable space.

findings.summary: The homepage logs runtime and network errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED to localhost.sensic.net and a Nuxt “Hydration completed but contains mismatches” console error.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the localhost request from production and resolve server/client markup divergence causing hydration mismatch.

findings.summary: Image delivery has aspect-ratio, sizing and responsiveness defects.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 26 oversized images, 85 without srcset, 30 legacy-format assets and 19 below-fold images not lazy-loaded; Lighthouse found an incorrectly stretched Bwin image.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide responsive srcset/sizes, correct intrinsic aspect ratios, modern formats and below-fold lazy loading.

findings.summary: Some consent links are not crawlable or progressively operable.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse SEO found three Didomi links using href="javascript:void(0)" instead of real destinations/actions.
findings.suggestedFix: Use buttons for actions and real href URLs for navigational privacy/vendor information.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie flags are materially incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers probe found no CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, clickjacking protection or Permissions-Policy and HSTS max-age only 300; all four observed first-party cookies lacked Secure and three used SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, long-lived HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer/Permissions policies, and mark HTTPS cookies Secure with the narrowest appropriate SameSite.

findings.summary: The homepage has an excessive tracking and third-party footprint.
findings.evidence: Tracker probe found 36 third-party origins and DoubleClick, GTM and AdSense; HAR attributed 147/169 requests and 3.97MB/4.20MB transferred bytes to third-party origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit vendors against user value, block nonessential tags until valid consent, remove duplicate tag managers, and batch/minimize analytics.

findings.summary: The Spanish document language is set, but CSS is not writing-mode resilient.
findings.evidence: Metadata probes confirmed html lang="es" across templates; DOM/CSS inspection found no logical-property use in the captured styles.
findings.suggestedFix: Prefer logical inline/block properties and set dir explicitly where bidirectional content can occur.

findings.summary: Image and decorative asset delivery wastes bandwidth.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 26 oversized images, 85/100 without srcset and 30 legacy-format files; HAR transferred 1.33MB of images, including a 269KB masthead SVG.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate responsive variants, use srcset/sizes, optimize SVGs and decorative imagery, and retain modern compressed formats.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts consume most of the page budget.
findings.evidence: Third-party resources accounted for 3.97MB and 147 requests; scripts alone transferred 2.49MB, while Lighthouse estimated 1.19MB unused JS.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party performance/carbon budget, remove low-value vendors and defer ad/media code until intent or consent.

findings.summary: The one-page memory footprint is disproportionate for a news listing.
findings.evidence: Baseline heap summary contained 867,694 nodes and 52.2MB self size; after repeated full-page traversal it remained about 868,331 nodes and 52.6MB. Growth was bounded, but the steady-state footprint is large.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce shipped/injected components and third-party runtimes, virtualize or defer below-fold modules, and establish a heap/node budget.
